mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause acute kidney injury; sulfamethoxazole may precipitate in renal tubules while gentamicin causes direct tubular toxicity, and reduced renal clearance of gentamicin increases ototoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and gentamicin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative to sulfamethoxazole if possible or use lowest effective gentamicin dose with extended dosing intervals.
